name: libvips
manual: Use an upstream Windows CLI build; no Chocolatey package is assumed.

name: Assimp
manual: Install/build the upstream Assimp command-line tools for Windows.

name: DjVuLibre
manual: Install the DjVuLibre Windows command-line tools.

name: dvisvgm
manual: Install dvisvgm from a Windows TeX distribution or upstream build.

name: Potrace
manual: Install the upstream Potrace Windows CLI.

name: Dasel
manual: Install the upstream Dasel Windows executable.

name: libjxl
manual: Install both JPEG XL encoder and decoder CLIs for Windows.

name: libheif
manual: Install/build libheif with its Windows conversion CLI.

name: XeLaTeX
manual: Install a Windows TeX distribution with latexmk, XeLaTeX, fonts and Perl.

name: resvg
manual: Install the upstream resvg Windows CLI.

name: VTracer
manual: Install the upstream VTracer Windows CLI.

name: MarkItDown
manual: Install markitdown[all] in a Python/pipx environment; pipx alone does not install it.

name: pdf2docx
manual: Install pdf2docx with pipx (pipx install pdf2docx) so PDF to Word keeps table borders.

name: msgconvert
manual: Requires Perl and Email::Outlook::Message plus a Windows-executable msgconvert wrapper. A bare Perl script on PATH is insufficient for execFile.
